summary: forshtat 提交“frame 交易替代内存池”ERC 草案，为不满足公共内存池规则的 frame 交易提供另一条传播路径。Julian Ma 解释快速确认规则（FCR）如何保持安全：FCR 是客户端本地运行的算法，不像最终性那样从链上读取。L2BEAT 把 Privacy Pools 的“网络观察者链接隐私”评为绿色，原因是前端支持自定义 RPC。khovratovich 讨论 Flock 出现后以太坊该用哪种哈希函数。

items.title: 新 ERC：frame 交易替代内存池
items.note: （forshtat）。EIP-8141 的公共内存池限制验证 gas、付款方和每个 sender 的待处理数量，不满足规则的交易需要另外的传播渠道，类似 ERC-4337 的替代内存池。
items.title_en: New ERC: frame transaction alternative mempools
items.note_en: (forshtat). EIP-8141's public mempool limits validation gas, payers and pending transactions per sender, so transactions that do not meet these rules need another channel, similar to ERC-4337's alternative mempools.

summary_en: forshtat submitted a draft ERC for "Frame Transaction Alternative Mempools", another propagation path for frame transactions that do not meet the public mempool rules. Julian Ma explained how the Fast Confirmation Rule (FCR) stays secure: FCR is an algorithm clients run locally rather than something read from the chain like finality. L2BEAT rated Privacy Pools green on link privacy against the network observer, thanks to custom RPC support in its frontend. khovratovich discussed which hash function Ethereum should use now that Flock exists.
